# Aspect Ratio Calculator

> Find your image aspect ratio and calculate the dimensions you need. Supporting video and ultrawide calculators. Free browser-based tools maintained by wherexml.

## Tools
- [Image aspect ratio calculator](https://imageaspectratio.com/): Read dimensions from a local photo and preview padding (Fit) or a centered crop (Fill) in common frames.
- [Aspect ratio calculator](https://imageaspectratio.com/calculator): Find an aspect ratio from width and height, calculate a matching width or height, or scale dimensions.
- [Video aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/video-aspect-ratio): Enter dimensions to compare frame fit; assumes square pixels.
- [Ultrawide calculator](https://imageaspectratio.com/ultrawide-aspect-ratio-calculator): Distinguish exact pixel ratios from the 21:9 category.

## Social media dimensions
- [TikTok aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/tiktok-aspect-ratio): Plan a vertical frame; distinguish working examples from ad specifications.
- [YouTube aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/youtube-aspect-ratio): Calculate 16:9 landscape dimensions and understand adaptive playback.
- [Instagram Reel aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/instagram-reel-aspect-ratio): Plan a 9:16 video; distinguish accepted shapes and cover framing.
- [Instagram Story aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/instagram-story-aspect-ratio): Plan a portrait photo/video canvas and distinguish Story ad guidance.
- [YouTube Shorts aspect ratio](https://imageaspectratio.com/youtube-shorts-aspect-ratio): Compare vertical and square geometry; consult official classification rules.

## Learn
- [What is aspect ratio?](https://imageaspectratio.com/what-is-aspect-ratio): An illustrated guide to width:height, common ratios, exact calculations, cropping, padding and stretching.

## About and support
- [About](https://imageaspectratio.com/about): Calculation methods, scope and maintainer.
- [Contact](https://imageaspectratio.com/contact): Public GitHub issue tracker.
- [Privacy](https://imageaspectratio.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://imageaspectratio.com/terms)
- [Source code](https://github.com/wherexml/image-aspect-ratio): MIT license.

## Limitations
Calculations use exact fractions; rounded pixel values are labeled. Fit/Fill are previews. The tool does not resize, crop, export or transcode files. Selected images are read locally in the browser. Open-source availability and indexability do not imply search engine ranking or endorsement.
